title: IMC 2026: PM Modi To Inaugurate 10th India Mobile Congress Tomorrow, With 6G, AI & Satellite Connectivity In Focus
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the 10th India Mobile Congress at Yashobhoomi, New Delhi, on October 8, with the event running until October 10. Organised by the DoT and COAI, IMC 2026 focuses on 6G, AI-ready networks, semiconductors, satellite communications and cybersecurity. Organisers expect over 1.5 lakh attendees, 500 exhibitors, 600 startups and 900 thought leaders.
